## The question

** Why are some songs listened across millions of people while some never make it out of someone's basement? We hope to discover what effects various musical elements have on the popularity of a music track on Spotify, by looking at the level of popularity across the duration of the song, the key, the tempo, the genre, the time signature, and whether or not it is explicit. 
We believe that this analysis will help music producers make better business decisions, as well as well-known and aspiring artists to produce more popular songs. 
We will look at 114,000 individual spotify music tracks on a dataset found on kaggle at https://doi.org/10.34740/kaggle/dsv/4372070. It is necessary to note that the process at which songs were given a popularity score seems as if it could be subjective and may not be the best or the only way to measure or predict popularity of a song. **
